_description: Quantify the gap between ERA5 reanalysis (Open-Meteo) and GHCND station observations (NOAA CDO) for Lansing, MI
_groundspring_question: How does a 10km gridded reanalysis differ from a point station measurement?

location.name: Lansing, MI

open_meteo.description: East Lansing / MSU campus grid cell

noaa_cdo.name: Lansing Capital City Airport
noaa_cdo.description: GHCND station — point measurement at airport

location._note: The stations are ~10km apart: MSU campus vs airport. ERA5 grid cell is ~10km, so they may fall in same or adjacent cells.

expected_characteristics._note: ERA5 tends to smooth extremes slightly
Precipitation is inherently more spatially variable than temperature

error_sources.spatial_representation: ERA5 averages over ~10km cell; station is a point
error_sources.temporal_aggregation: Observation hours may differ (local midnight vs UTC)
error_sources.instrument_vs_model: Station: thermometer/gauge; Reanalysis: assimilated model output
error_sources.microclimate: Airport vs campus have different land use (concrete vs grass)
error_sources.elevation_difference: 3-5m potential elevation difference between grid cell and station

acceptance_criteria._note: These are conservative thresholds for model-observation agreement
